properties: Requires pinned SHA256 for reader and entrypoint before deployment.
Captures original service PathName, StartMode, StartName and original preflight SHA before changing anything.
Changes only candidate files, service binPath and service start mode; does not alter SQL permissions.
After start, requires service identity to remain NT SERVICE\TataComandaReader and checkpoint to appear.
Any failed post-start invariant triggers narrow rollback to the captured original service configuration.
Narrow rollback does not delete SQL login/user or the whole runtime.
No print, spooler, Odhen write, fiscal or SEFAZ surface exists in the package.
reason_not_executed: Continuous production service cutover remains a distinct reversible production effect; package is prepared while physical printing is deferred.
